supported_at_locator: Mundari (Horo-jagar) is listed among Eastern Munda/Kherwari languages.
The fascicle reports nearly 600,000 Mundari speakers, mainly in southern and western Ranchi District, using population figures stated to derive from the 1951 Census unless otherwise indicated.
The indexed passage lists Mundari proper, Hasada, Naguri and Kera as Mundari dialect labels.
mundari_relevance.temporal_scope: historical; population baseline stated as 1951 Census unless otherwise indicated
mundari_relevance.geographic_scope: historical administrative geography; Bihar/Ranchi wording must not be silently mapped to current Jharkhand boundaries

quality_and_dependency.source_role: secondary comparative survey drawing demographic figures from Census material
quality_and_dependency.dependency_warning: Population figures are derivative of historical Census reporting and must not be counted as independent corroboration of Census claims.
